text:
Lina: Quick sync for Nimbus POC. Customer wants invoice extraction + a context-aware QA chat. Two-week timeline. Need: full prompt inventory, baseline prompts for each flow, pass/fail criteria, and rough pricing for hosted vs dedicated. Can we align owners?
Tom: I can own infra + hosted demo. Clarify two flows: (1) structured extraction from PDF OCR, (2) retrieval-augmented QA with citations. Will we surface embeddings for the retrieval index?
Rakesh: Yes, embeddings + simple vector store for QA. For extraction, we'll use pattern-aware prompts plus post-parse normalization. Customer asked for demo latency ~250ms p95; propose we offer two SLAs (demo comfortable vs production).
Hannah: Suggested POC acceptance criteria draft:
- Extraction: >=94% field-level F1 on their 60-sample test set
- QA: >=80% human-rated helpfulness across 100 queries; <7% hallucination rate in spot checks
- Stability: demo p95 latency <300ms (hosted) or <180ms (dedicated)
Ivy: Security checklist: they want KMS-backed keys, data retention <=30 days, and evidence of SOC2 controls. Also asked a short narrative: "how we protect customer data during model training/serving." We'll provide a paragraph.
Lina: Can someone draft the short security blurb for the questionnaire? Keep it customer-facing and non-technical.
Rakesh: I'll draft: one-paragraph explaining ephemeral caching, optional private deployment, and KMS usage. Share by EOD Day 1.
Tom: Prompt inventory (initial):
- extract/invoice_json_v1 ": instruction prompt to output JSON with invoice_id,date,total,vendor,line_items[]"
- extract/normalize_currency_v1: normalizes currency strings to ISO and cents
- qa/system_retrieval_v1: system prompt describing citation-first answers and fallback to "I don't know"
- qa/safety_guardrail_v1: answer policy to refuse hallucinations and request docs when unsure
Example snippet:
```
# extract/invoice_json_v1
Instruction: "Given OCR text, return only JSON with keys: invoice_id, date, vendor, total_amount_cents, currency, line_items (array of {desc,qty,unit_price_cents}). If field not present, use null."
```
Ivy: For evals: we'll run automated checks for exact JSON keys + normalization tests, plus a human validation sheet for ambiguous OCR. Use 60 real invoices + 20 stress test files (rotated pages, weird fonts).
Hannah: Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: Kickoff + sec questionnaire sent
- Day 1-2: Baseline prompts + infra setup (hosted demo token)
- Day 3-6: Extraction baseline + automated evals
- Day 7-10: QA retrieval integration + human evals
- Day 11-13: Buffer + final prep
- Day 14: Demo & pass/fail review
Tom: Repo layout I'll push:
- prompts/ (plain .txt files per prompt)
- evals/ (unit tests, CSV template for human raters)
- infra/ (demo runbook, docker compose for hosted sandbox)
qa-bot: [notice] Demo slot reserved 2024-05-27T15:00Z on pool sandbox-demo-2.
Lina: Pricing quick note: hosted POC estimate ~$900 for two weeks (assumes small model sizes + batching). Dedicated: need sizing call; ballpark $4k/month minimum commitment. We'll caveat that in the customer email.
Rakesh: Who owns the pass/fail report? I can own the eval CSV and initial analysis; Hannah can sign off on human ratings.
Hannah: OK I'll own human annotation coordination. Rakesh, ping me when the CSV template is ready.
Tom: Small technical suggestion: enable KV prefix caching for the retrieval flow to cut demo token costs; include config in infra/runbook.
Lina: Actions: Lina send sec questionnaire + timeline to customer; Rakesh draft security blurb and prompt baseline; Tom push repo skeleton and infra runbook; Hannah coordinate annotators; Ivy prepare the security evidence doc. We'll reconvene Day 3. :thumbsup:
Lina: Uploading sample invoices to shared drive now: https://drive.google.com/nimbus-samples (shared).
Ivy: Got samples. I'll start preparing the SOC2 summary and encryption notes.
Tom: I'll create the skeleton repo and share link by EOD.
Hannah: Scheduling Day 3 check-in for Friday 09:30 PT.
Lina: Thanks team, closing thread here and will update with questionnaire link after sending."
